data.name: Shailesh Wagh
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Shailesh Wagh has made a big mark in cricket. With 35 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 65, with an average of 21.67 and a quick strike rate of 143.65. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 25 sixes and 42 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 30.0 overs, taking 8 wickets at an economy rate of 11.17. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
